title: Pipeline rules
description: Household-specific classification rules read by pipeline/build_ledger.py and pipeline/aggregate.py. Keys not listed here are ignored by the pipeline, so they are rejected on save.

cpi_base_month.description: Month (YYYY-MM) whose dollars the real-dollars toggle expresses everything in. Must be a month in the CPI index. Empty (null) means the latest CPI month.

people.description: The earners/payers in the household, for example ["Rosie", "Sam"].

income_by_person.description: Person -> CanonicalItem names that are that person's income, for example {"Rosie": ["Paycheck"]}. Other income is attributed to Household.

payer_prefix_by_person.description: Person -> item-name prefixes that mark their personal spending, for example {"Rosie": ["Rosie "]}. Remember the trailing space.

payer_items_by_person.description: Person -> explicit CanonicalItem names that are their personal spending. Tried after the prefixes; anything unmatched is Household.

match.description: Regular expression searched in the lower-cased paycheck merchant, for example "hobbiton mill".

name.description: Employer name shown on the dashboard.

employers.description: Paycheck merchants -> employer names. The first entry whose match is found in the merchant wins.

month.description: Last budget month (YYYY-MM) the fallback applies to.

employer_before.description: Fallback for paychecks with no matching merchant in budget months up to and including month.

debt_plug_until.description: Budget month (YYYY-MM) up to which positive debt "Interest" rows are balancing plugs rather than payments.

transfer_item_words.description: Regular expression of item-name words that mark a transfer between envelopes ("Transfer to <word>"). Empty (null) uses the built-in generic list: savings, checking, emergency fund, sinking fund, slush, fund, budget.

transfer_merchants.description: Regular expression of whole merchant names (case-insensitive) that are moves between envelopes, for example "second breakfast fund|party tree rebalance". Tried alongside the built-in transfer, rebalance and redistribution names.

item_name_suffixes.description: Regular expressions (case-insensitive) for the endings an envelope's name gains from year to year, for example ["\\s+\\d+", "\\s+fund", "\\s+goal"], so that "Second Breakfast 2" and "Second Breakfast Fund" are recognised as "Second Breakfast". Used by the Item mapping hints and the mapping draft, not by the build. Empty (null) uses those three.

transfer_item_names.description: Regular expression of whole item names (case-insensitive) that are moves between your own envelopes, drafted with Flow transfer, for example "fund transfers?|transfer funds?|.*rebalance". Used by the mapping draft only. Empty (null) uses a built-in list: Fund Transfer, Transfer Funds, anything ending in Rebalance, Transfer to/from …

verify_transfer_prefixes.description: CanonicalItem prefixes whose rows mapped with the verify flow are moves between envelopes rather than spending, for example ["Slush"]. Empty keeps every verify row on the verify list.

offbudget_since.description: Budget month (YYYY-MM) from which unpaired off-budget outflows are counted on the Exclusions table.

merchant_rules.description: Pairs [regex, display name] that tidy merchant names, for example ["green dragon", "Green Dragon Inn"]. Tried in order, before the built-in rules.

catchall_items.description: CanonicalItem names that tend to act as catch-alls, for example ["Emergency Fund", "Taxes"]. The Where it went tab charts their spending by year; empty hides the chart.

paycheck_min.description: A paycheck row (paycheck_items) above this many dollars counts as one deposit (paycheck counts on the Goals tab and the employer chart); smaller ones are deductions. Empty (null) means 500.

goal_giving_categories.description: Categories whose spending counts as giving on the Goals tab. Empty (null) means ["Giving"].

goal_housing_categories.description: Categories counted against the housing cap on the Goals tab. Empty (null) means ["Housing", "Utilities"].

goal_savings_groups.description: Budget groups whose planned amounts count toward the savings target on the Goals tab, for example ["Long-expected Party"]. Empty leaves that ratio blank.

paycheck_items.description: Items that are paychecks: CanonicalItem names whose rows get an employer (the employers rule), count as deposits (paycheck_min), and make up the Employer chart, the Goals tab's take-home and the review's paycheck count. A list, so Salary and Contract Income can stay apart. Empty (null) means ["Paycheck"].

recurring_categories.description: Categories the Recurring tab lists: their expense rows, by canonical item. Empty (null) means ["Subscriptions", "Utilities", "Insurance"].

contract_income_items.description: Canonical items of income with no tax withheld (contract, self-employment): estimated tax is set aside from them (#153). Empty means none, and no estimated tax is shown anywhere.

tax_set_aside_items.description: The envelopes (canonical items) or accounts the estimated tax is set aside in (#153).

tax_deadlines.description: Estimated-tax deadlines, as budget months with a label: [{"m": "YYYY-MM", "label": "Q3 federal estimate"}]. Kept current by the household: they move with weekends and holidays and differ by state (#153).

yearly_bill_tolerance.description: A yearly bill is paid within this many months of the same calendar month each year (#151). Empty (null) means 1.

yearly_bill_min_years.description: A yearly bill is one paid in at least this many of the last three budget years (#151). Empty (null) means 2.

decision_partly_over.description: A spend-cap decision missed by up to this share of its cap counts as partly kept, not dropped (#155). Empty (null) means 0.10.

decision_partly_share.description: A save or extra-payment decision that reaches this share of its aim counts as partly kept (#155). Empty (null) means 0.5.

plan_keep_categories.description: Categories whose suggested plan on the Last month tab stays the current plan instead of the twelve-month average. Empty (null) means ["Housing", "Debt", "Insurance"].

income_groups.description: Budget groups that hold income, as they appear in the export. An inflow whose merchant equals its item name is a carry-forward into a fund everywhere except in these groups; new source profiles and the mapping draft start from them. Empty (null) means ["Income"].

debt_groups.description: Budget groups that hold debt payments, as they appear in the export: the debt_plug_until rule looks at these groups, the off-budget outflow count leaves them out, and the mapping draft gives their items Flow debt. Empty (null) means ["Debt"].

assumed_growth_pct.description: The look ahead's yearly growth for asset balances, in percent (5 means 5% a year). It applies to assets only, never to cash flow, and every figure that uses it says so. Empty (null) means none: the look ahead assumes no investment return.

year_start_month.description: The month the household's year starts (1 = January). The check-in runs in year mode on the year's last budget month and in quarter mode on each quarter's last. Empty (null) means 1.

debt_paid_off_months.description: A debt with no payment in this many of the latest budget months is folded under "Paid off" on the Debts tab. 0 folds nothing. Empty (null) means 3.

loan_categories.description: Categories of loans between family or friends. The Method tab counts their inflows (kept out of income) and repayments (kept out of spend). Empty (null) means ["Family Loan"].
